thread:
maya: Quick pre-week check — dedicated GPU slate alignment. Need final owner signoffs for procurement/reservations, rack power confirmation, and canary window. Pinging owners: @alex (infra), @jamal (runtime), @sarah (sre). TL;DR: procurement ETA, reservation gaps, PR merge for reservation automation.

alex: Procurement update: vendor confirmed 24 x A100 shipments, ETA 6/20. FedEx manifest sent. Waiting final ASN from procurement. Split shipment option available (12/12) if we want earlier capacity. :thumbsup:

maya: Split shipment is fine but we need reserved slots immediately for canary. Who owns the reservation step? @leo to do PR?

leo: I can own reservation slot allocation. I'll finish the PR today and add the `reservation-owner` label. pinging @jamal for canary node tagging review. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482

jamal: Canaries — runtime checks we need: KV cache warmup hook, runtime warmup script, and sequence-length smoke. I can run staging canary on first 4 nodes once reservations are confirmed. ETA for my tests: tomorrow EOD.

sarah: SRE notes: rack power capacity ok for 12 nodes/rack but PDU mapping needs labeling. Ops team needs to be on-site for cross-connects during initial boot. On-call rota: @sre-oncall will be assigned day of arrival.

buildbot: Reservation system snapshot: 12/24 nodes reserved for 'canary' tag, 4/24 tagged 'staging', 8/24 unreserved. (snapshot at 1751112285)

alex: Action items: procurement to share ASN by EOD. Infra to confirm physical slot mapping by 6/18. @leo to push PR and include `reservation-owner` label in PR body so CI can pick it up.

leo: Noted. Will add label. Also need one CR from @maya before merge.

maya: I'll review by lunchtime PST. If all green, we run the canary the following day. :rocket:

jamal: FYI, I'll include a quick check in the canary to assert p99 < 100ms for short sequences. If it fails, fallback is to route traffic to reserve pool and abort rollout.

sarah: Ack. I'll prepare a runbook stub at /docs/oncall/dedicated-canary.md and assign a reviewer. Please add any failure cases you want covered.

maya: Cool — final checklist: ASN -> slot map, PR merged, canary warmups, runbook. Post blockers here.

leo: One blocker: CI needs Vault secret access for the reservation script. @ops-sec will need to grant `reservations/ci` read scope.

maya: Looping in @ops-sec. /cc @ops-sec :eyes:

ops-sec: Granted read-only token to CI role; will DM token to the infra CI account and rotate in 24h.

maya: Thanks. Last note — can we lock 4 nodes for canary tomorrow 09:00 PT to minimize interference?

jamal: Locking 4 nodes at 09:00 PT. I'll post a short run plan with steps and expected smoke outputs.

buildbot: Reminder: next reservation cron runs 02:00 UTC — if PR lands before that, allocation will auto-apply.

maya: Ok thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
